scientific_source.published_design: 469 fixed patches; 11 years; two semesters per year; patch canopy biomass used to define recorded occupancy dynamics

response_blind_evidence.note: The patch-definition dataset is a physically distinct EDI package from the semi-annual biomass/fecundity time series and the dispersal-time package. The article describes 469 patch centroids with nearest-neighbour distances ranging 0.06-4.3 km and evaluates all patches over two semesters per year. No EDI response row is opened at preflight.

future_endpoint_boundary: recorded semi-annual canopy reappearance among source-semester recorded non-detections; not latent biological colonisation or true absence
no_rescue: do not choose spatial thresholds from canopy response rows
do not use published outcome direction to tune Layer B
do not weaken the strong process-aware baseline
do not identify patch canopy non-detection as latent biological absence
do not alter preflight minima after response access
next_if_ready: freeze exact EDI geometry package metadata/file identity and run structural geometry gate without opening biomass/fecundity response rows
